original.statement: The v1alpha1 EnvironmentConfig API version is dropped in Crossplane 2.0.0.

decision.reason: [ev-a7745aa0308c] says only that v1alpha1 EnvironmentConfigs are dropped in 2.0.0. The exposed environments are the ones whose manifests use the v1alpha1 EnvironmentConfig kind, which is the standard gvk-in-use shape for a removed API version. The evidence does not name the API group, so leaving the group out (rather than adding core.crossplane.io as P1 did) matches what the text says. No validator confirmed or refuted the subject, so confidence is low.
